title: Local pilot harness for Member, Trainer and Admin

surfaces.member: client-app fixture preview; explicit preview=1; no API calls
surfaces.trainer: staff-app backed by a dedicated API process with development-only trainer role
surfaces.admin: admin-web backed by a dedicated API process with development-only admin role

safety: No production credentials, data, deployment, DNS, TLS, Cloudflare or production auth changes.
No changes to 2jfitnessapp or Training; Training URL remains https://app.2jfitnesscenter.com.
Launcher clears inherited Training service credentials and the member app API base URL.
Web and API bind to loopback only.
Existing local services and database containers are not terminated or modified.

verification.postgres_migrations: 24 checksummed migrations verified on a fresh local test database
verification.pilot_smoke: all 5 loopback app/API processes responded; Trainer/Admin CORS origins verified; stop/restart verified without disturbing pre-existing port 5173 listener
